biography: Ricke graced the Hector Trophée on two distinct occasions, carving out a concise yet notable chapter in the tournament's history. His participation, though brief, contributed to the fabric of the esteemed pairs competition, reflecting the diverse range of talent that has challenged its fairways over the years.

During these two outings, Ricke approached the demanding format with earnest endeavor. Despite his dedicated efforts on the course, neither the coveted Hector Trophée for his pairing nor the individual Victor Trophy for singular excellence was secured. His presence, however, was marked by an unwavering commitment to the competition's spirit.

As the Hector Trophée 2026 approaches, Ricke is understood to have concluded his active engagement with Hector events. While he will not be among the competitors this year, his prior appearances remain a part of the tournament's enduring record, a testament to his brief but determined journey within this annual golf spectacle.
